title: Private stormwater or sewage disposal system.
officialText:
If a private stormwater or sewage disposal system is to be installed, a site
and subsoil evaluation indicating that the site and subsoil conditions comply with the applicable laws and rules shall be submitted in
accordance with the provisions of Section 1704.20.1 of the New York City Building Code.
